                 Corpus of longer narrative Slovene prose 
                                 KDSP 1.0

       Citation, documentation, download, and licence available from
                      http://hdl.handle.net/11356/1823

This directory contains the TEI encoded corpus without linguistic
annotations. The TEI encoding follows the CLARIN.SI TEI customisation
(https://github.com/clarinsi/TEI-schema).
